annotations.title: Compare the files you share in a private conversation or group chat between two commits

description: Compare the files you share in a private conversation or group chat between two commits. Use it to see exactly what changed since a commit you know, before you build on it: every file that differs between `from` and `to` (default: now), and a unified diff of their texts. With `path`, one file only. `from` 0 compares with the state before the first commit. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

from.description: The earlier commit. 0 is the state before the first commit: no files.

space_id.description: Whose files these are: the `conversation_id` of a conversation you take part in, or the `group_id` of a group you are a member of.

name: diff_files
title: Compare the files you share in a private conversation or group chat between two commits
